v1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Game-ready furniture sprite sheet for ONE Chinese rural Sichuan home, the grape-pergola courtyard household. Completely new furniture designs, a coherent lived-in set in warm old elm wood, woven rattan, muted aubergine cloth, jade green enamel and tiny grape-purple accents.
Make ONE transparent RGBA sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024. Exactly EIGHT isolated objects in a strict evenly spaced 4-column by 2-row grid. Each cell is 384x512, containing exactly one entire object, safely within the cell with generous transparent margins. No labels, no drawn grid, no background floor or wall, no scenery, no characters, no text. Real alpha transparency.
Top row left to right: (1) low rectangular elm dining table, four sturdy legs, simple chipped jade teapot and a SMALL bowl of grapes on top, no attached chairs; (2) low two-person rattan bench with woven back and aubergine cushion, frontal, a clearly empty seat to place a game character; (3) plain sturdy elm single bed with tall slatted headboard, folded indigo grape-vine quilt and cream pillow, head away from camera feet toward camera; (4) old slender two-door elm pantry cupboard with a louvered upper door, squat jars inside and a small wicker basket on top.
Bottom row left to right: (5) compact two-burner whitewashed brick kitchen stove and attached short preparation counter, jade enamel washbowl and iron wok; (6) old rattan two-seat settee with plum textile cushion, rustic proportions not luxury; (7) wide grape sorting worktable with a shallow wicker grape tray, pruning shears and a folded cloth, distinct from the dining table; (8) small freestanding bamboo-framed square lantern with warm cream light, no glow outside its silhouette.
Camera: all objects use the SAME top-down oblique 3/4 RPG view, front faces square to camera, see the top surfaces at about 35 degrees, NO isometric diamond rotation. Every item orthographic, not photographic.
CRITICAL ART STYLE: authentic CHUNKY low-resolution pixel sprites, as if individually drawn at roughly 48-80 pixels wide and scaled 5x with nearest-neighbor. Large plainly visible square pixel clusters, stepped silhouettes and hard block shadows; 2-3 flat shades per material, dark brown single-pixel outline scaled consistently. Coarse deliberate clusters on every surface, NOT smooth lineart, NOT painterly strokes, NOT hand-painted illustration, NOT detailed high-resolution textures, NOT blurry pixelation filter. Flat warm daylight, no cast shadows extending beyond each sprite. Rich but controlled distinct colors. Cohesive everyday Sichuan village home, modest and practical. Do not borrow any existing house's furniture.
